content: कुच् I. €6 <ab>P.</ab> (कुचति, कुचित) .²1 To utter a shrill cry (as a bird). .²2 To go. .²3 To polish. .²4 To contract, bend. .²5 To be contracted. .²6 To stop, impede. .²7 To write or delineate. .²8 To mix, connect. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab> कुञ्च् also (कोचति, कुञ्चति कुञ्चित) .²1 To make crooked, bend or curve. .²2 To move or go crookedly. .²3 To make small, lessen. .²4 To shrink, contract. .²5 To go to or towards.
